novel_claims: Shift identity/annihilator folding (Block G) closes the algebraic-identity coverage gap for shift operations — OpShl/OpShr now have both shift-by-zero identity and zero-shift annihilator rules, completing algebraic identity coverage for all common binary ops (add/sub/mul/div/rem/bitwise/compare/branch/shift)

The Block E→G chain (comparison fold product drives shift zero-annihilator) demonstrates cross-instruction constant propagation within a single forward pass, eliminating dead register chains without a second iteration
